input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale:
The IP package meets our preferred position. §14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right (reinforced by §15.1's no-sale/no-advertising/no-model-training limits). §14.2 vests ownership of Deliverables in Customer with an express Vendor assignment, including personnel assignments and further-assurance. §14.3 leaves Vendor with only its pre-existing Vendor Technology and routes any embedded Vendor Technology to the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business. §14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument and keeps feedback rights unrestricted for us. The only sub-preferred details are the "subject to payment of the applicable Fees" condition on Deliverable ownership and the absence of an express sublicensing word in §13.2 (contractor support is permitted) — noted, not material enough to redline.</parationale>
